profileEvidence.author: C
profileEvidence.summary: Affectionate and animated, Setters combine close companionship with a strong interest in gamebirds. English, Gordon, Irish and Irish Red and White Setters are distinct breeds with a shared bird-finding tradition. They locate birds by scent and pause to signal their find; the name recalls the low crouch once used while hunters cast nets.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Affectionate, animated bird dogs, Setters share a scent-led hunting tradition across four distinct British and Irish breeds.
